name: Onboarding completes and Today hero renders

planSteps.description: The app opens on the Winter Arc onboarding wizard starting from a clean profile. Click the Continue button 5 times to walk through Season, Dates, Identity, Practices and Study chapters, then click Start Day 1.
The Today page appears showing Day 1 in the hero, the sentence starting with Who are you becoming, and the sections SPIRITUAL, STUDY, PHYSICAL and QUIET RESISTANCE.
